verdict.rationale: The B300 is hardware, but the DGX B300 ships its own management surface: a BMC with remote KVM and Redfish/IPMI management. That gives programmatic, API-based control of the system, so the axis applies. The evidence never describes a management UI or shows that the API matches it. missing for 10: documentation of the BMC/management UI feature set, an explicit statement or mapping of API-to-UI parity, Redfish API reference coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration that UI actions can all be done via API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) ... Remote keyboard, video, mouse (KVM) ... Remote storage ... RedFish, IPMI management
